args.sql:
SELECT p.babylon_guid, p.catalog_id, p.provisioned_at, p.retired_at, p.status, u.email
FROM provisions p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id
WHERE p.sandbox_name = 'sandbox9174'
ORDER BY p.provisioned_at DESC
LIMIT 5
